trigger.description: Native episodic summary discovery observes more than 128 current source rows in its deterministic window, skips a source body over 16384 bytes, or limits a coherent cluster to 16 sources per proposal. Targeted discovery puts the requested source first and restricts its window to the same kind/workflow; it does not prove exhaustive neighborhood coverage. The response may contain zero candidates without proving no related sources exist.
setup_commands: # Store more than 128 current episodic memories, or a coherent cluster containing more than 16 distinct source bodies.

expected_emission.repair_string: Use --target-memory <source-id> to inspect a bounded source neighborhood, or use ee curate propose-derived with explicitly reviewed sources.
